title: ZK-Werewolf
tagline: A game where zkp is used to implement the werewolf social game on-chain, with AI players integrated with chatgpt
description: This is an attempt to implement the classic social game --- werewolf or mafia --- on blockchain using zero knowledge proofs. ZK primitives such as zk shuffling was implemented. Some basic (and dumb) AI players are made. The problem revealed a few limitations of the current blockchain infra, such as the speed bottleneck and the lack of session key, both of which are essential for gaming.
how_its_made: ZK was built using circom. On-chain development is all solidity. Frontend is vite, react, ethers. The chats are generated by chatgpt and routed through a minimalist chat server. The on-chain part is broken into several contracts due to the size limitation. I tried using wagmi but it didn't work somehow.
